transcript.text: Most fridge freezer sounds are normal, so the type of sound matters. What does it sound like — gurgling or cracking, clicking, a hum or buzz, squealing or grinding, or rattling?
its a beeping, like an alarm. also theres a red flashing light on the display
Next, where it's coming from. Is the noise from inside the fridge or freezer, or from the back / bottom outside?
its coming from the display on the front of the fridge door, I think

Thanks for letting us know where you heard that noise. A fridge freezer typically cycles on and off; it runs for a while then goes quiet as the compressor rests. This is normal operation. We are trying to determine if this pattern matches your appliance or if there is an issue with the cooling cycle. Does it ever go quiet, or does it seem to run all the time?
the beeping doesn't stop, its constant. fridge is cold and freezer seems to be running though

Thanks for letting us know it is still running constantly. Please switch the fridge freezer off at the socket and unplug it first. Do not open, bend or pierce any of the pipes or the cooling circuit as it is sealed and needs a refrigeration engineer. Ease it out from the wall and check nothing at the back is touching the wall, cupboards or the pipes. Ensure the drip tray on top of the motor is sitting properly, and that it stands level and firm. Was something touching, loose or not level (and have you sorted it), or was it all clear?

Please switch the fridge freezer off at the socket and unplug it first. Do not open, bend or pierce any of the pipes or the cooling circuit as it is sealed and needs a refrigeration engineer. If the coil or grille at the back or underneath is dusty, or if it is pushed against the wall, the appliance works harder and louder. Gently dust or vacuum it and leave a few centimetres of space. Was it dusty or tight against the wall (and have you sorted it), or was it already clean with space?
